Method II: net wages = wages - Table A allowance for the payroll period; apply the per-period table (weekly/biweekly/semimonthly/monthly/daily) or the Annual Tax Rate Schedule for annual payrolls: (net - col3) x col4 + col5. Annualised net wages (net x payroll periods) are used only to test the Method III threshold. Other periods: convert via a factor to a common period, apply its table, convert the result back (p.23).
Method III: annualized wages = Method II net wages x payroll periods per year (e.g. 52, 26, 24, 12); x column 3 rate; / payroll periods = amount to withhold.
